verses.english: Linked Discourses 55.22
3. About Sarakāni
With Mahānāma (2nd)
So I have heard.

verses.pali: ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṁ nigrodhārāme.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying in the land of the Sakyans, near Kapilavatthu in the Banyan Tree Monastery.

verses.pali: Atha kho mahānāmo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then Mahānāma the Sakyan went up to the Buddha, bowed, sat down to one side, and said to him:

verses.pali: “idaṁ, bhante, kapilavatthu iddhañceva phītañca bāhujaññaṁ ākiṇṇamanussaṁ sambādhabyūhaṁ.
verses.english: “Sir, this Kapilavatthu is successful and prosperous, populous, full of people, with cramped cul-de-sacs.

verses.pali: So khvāhaṁ, bhante, bhagavantaṁ vā payirupāsitvā manobhāvanīye vā bhikkhū sāyanhasamayaṁ kapilavatthuṁ pavisanto;
verses.english: In the late afternoon, after paying homage to the Buddha or an esteemed mendicant, I enter Kapilavatthu.
I encounter a stray elephant,
horse,
chariot,
cart,
or person.

verses.pali: Tassa mayhaṁ, bhante, tasmiṁ samaye mussateva bhagavantaṁ ārabbha sati, mussati dhammaṁ ārabbha sati, mussati saṅghaṁ ārabbha sati.
verses.english: At that time I lose mindfulness regarding the Buddha, the teaching, and the Saṅgha.
I think:

verses.pali: ‘imamhi cāhaṁ samaye kālaṁ kareyyaṁ, kā mayhaṁ gati, ko abhisamparāyo’”ti?
verses.english: ‘If I were to die at this time, where would I be reborn in my next life?’”
“Do not fear, Mahānāma, do not fear!

verses.pali: Apāpakaṁ te maraṇaṁ bhavissati apāpikā kālaṅkiriyā.
verses.english: Your death will not be a bad one; your passing will not be a bad one.

verses.pali: Catūhi kho, mahānāma, dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro.
verses.english: A noble disciple who has four things slants, slopes, and inclines towards extinguishment.
What four?

verses.pali: Idha, mahānāma, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti—
verses.english: It’s when a noble disciple has experiential confidence in the Buddha …

verses.pali: itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṁ buddho bhagavāti.

verses.english: the teaching …
the Saṅgha …

verses.pali: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṁvattanikehi.
verses.english: And they have the ethical conduct loved by the noble ones … leading to immersion.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, mahānāma, rukkho pācīnaninno pācīnapoṇo pācīnapabbhāro, so mūlacchinno katamena papateyyā”ti?
verses.english: Suppose there was a tree that slants, slopes, and inclines to the east. If it was cut off at the root where would it fall?”

verses.pali: “Yena, bhante, ninno yena poṇo yena pabbhāro”ti.
verses.english: “Sir, it would fall in the direction that it slants, slopes, and inclines.”

verses.pali: “Evameva kho, mahānāma, imehi catūhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro”ti.
verses.english: “In the same way, a noble disciple who has four things slants, slopes, and inclines towards extinguishment.”
